title: Global Existence of Weak Martingale Solutions to the Camassa-Holm Equation with Linear Multiplicative Noise
summary: In this paper, we consider the global existence and properties of $H^1$ martingale solution to the Camassa-Holm equation with linear multiplicative noise under periodic boundary conditions. The solution is obtained as limit of regular viscous approximate solutions to parabolic SPDEs, which are constructed using the Galerkin approximations ans the stochastic compactness method. The proof of convergence to a solution argues via tightness of the laws of the viscous approximations and Skorokhod-Jakubowski a.s. representations of random variables in quasi-Polish spaces.
